ev.q: Coverage with the updated COVID-19 vaccine among adults aged ≥65 years was 42% as of February 3, 2024
during October 2023–January 2024, 67% of all COVID-19–associated hospitalizations were among persons aged ≥65 years
On February 28, 2024, ACIP recommended that all persons aged ≥65 years receive 1 additional dose of any updated COVID-19 vaccine
In 2018, ACIP adopted the Evidence to Recommendations framework to guide the development of vaccine recommendations.
